whatItDoes:
MEASURE RR: Shall the City Charter be amended to prohibit evictions based on non-
      payment of rent when a tenant owes less than one month of the average of fair market
      rents, set annually by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, for ZIP
      codes in Santa Monica?
